title: 6/11–6/17 decision and dashboard streak inflated above the real MLB streak (max(model, contest)); fetch discarded the current activeStreak; doubles frozen
tier_reason: state impact: live pick decisions (including double-down eligibility) and the dashboard ran on a streak higher than the real contest streak, and doubles were frozen

contract.text: The decision streak and the dashboard's real-streak figure equal the real MLB contest streak (last confirmed) and are never raised by the model's replay of suggested picks; a current contest activeStreak is persisted even when per-round coverage lags.
contract.source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-17-real-streak-anchoring-design.md §P1.1–P1.2 (the 5/29 design 2890b2c already made contest state drive live picks)

mechanism.text: load_decision_streak_state's stale branch returned streak = max(model_streak, contest.streak) with allow_double=False; the model streak is a forward replay of the bot's suggested picks, which counted the missed 6/11 double-down as entered, so whenever the contest observation was stale (almost every evening) the inflated model value drove decisions and the dashboard and doubles were frozen

the contest observation stayed stale because fetch-contest-streak's currentness gate refused to write whenever source_date (the latest settled row of the per-round predictions array, which lags MLB's activeStreak counter by about a round) was earlier than the latest local resolved pick — silently for a one-step lag after 8cd7207 — and it also refused when source_date was None, so a current activeStreak was discarded
derive_source_date's RESOLVED set omitted MLB's profile value 'not_hit', so settled misses did not count toward source_date, biasing freshness against reset days

the noon-ET escalation (4f13eb3) read a one-step source_date gap persisting past noon as a possible missed entry, but that gap is the normal coverage lag of the per-round array, so it produced a daily false WARN; gap >= 2 could page a false CRITICAL on a transient ledger lag

mitigated.action: manual contest_streak.manual.json override asserting the real streak + a box-side nohup guard (/tmp/override_guard_2026-06-17.py) until Phase 1 shipped

residual.text: Phase-1 limitation: when the contest state is stale the decision uses the last-confirmed contest streak, which can over-state the real streak after an unposted miss; the boundary-aware uncertainty guard (Phase 2 PART B, 2b) was deferred and no later commit shows it built.
56f9726 deliberately dropped the never-entered-pick detection the noon WARN approximated; until check-pick-entered v2 (7/04) a missed entry had no detector.
Local state can still diverge from the contest in other paths (6/24 local replay above the contest value).

watchdog.trigger: after each contest fetch (01:10/02:10/10:30/13:30 ET) and before each pick decision, the decision streak differs from the latest fetched contest activeStreak, or the latest fetch pulled an activeStreak it did not persist, or the local model streak exceeds the contest streak by more than one settlement step
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the persisted contest snapshot equals the latest fetched activeStreak, the decision streak equals it (status fresh or lagged), and the dashboard shows the same number with its as-of label

evidence.what: incident 2026-06-17: the dashboard reported streak 10 while the real MLB streak was 8; recommendations incl. double-down ran off the wrong number and doubles were frozen; the stale branch took max(10, 7); the fetch pulled activeStreak=8 but the gate refused it ('source_date 2026-06-15 < latest resolved pick 2026-06-16'); the gap is the missed 6/11 double-down
a 6/17 manual override plus a box-side guard (/tmp/override_guard_2026-06-17.py, nohup) bridge the incident until Phase 1 lands
reproduces and fixes the 2026-06-17 incident (dashboard showed 10 vs real MLB 8 after a missed 6/11 entry): no max(model, contest), no staleness DD-freeze
gap==1 is the normal coverage lag -> INFO at any time ('was a daily false WARN past noon'); gap>=2 downgraded CRITICAL -> WARN so a transient ledger lag cannot page a false CRITICAL
RESOLVED lacked 'not_hit'; the snapshot was discarded when source_date was None; the CLI currentness gate refused a current activeStreak — all three removed/fixed on 6/17
